verdict.rationale: Carta documents a REST API with reference pages and a Postman guide. Nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec, and probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404. The Postman guide only says how to access the APIs through Postman; it does not say a spec or collection file can be downloaded.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
